description:
The owner asked for two external reviewers (agy and muse) on the site-repo split plan. muse reviewed it on 2026-10-06; agy was out of quota (HTTP 429). Owner decision D20 (2026-10-06): proceed with muse alone and run agy as the first step of the batch.

Steps:
1. Build a self-contained brief: agy headless runs cannot use tools, so inline the plan text and the verified repository facts. Dispatch it as a Soft Read-Only reviewer in a detached worktree at the current develop head, using `agy --model gemini-3.8-flash-high --mode plan --print="$BRIEF"`. Do not pass `--effort`. macOS has no `timeout`; bound the run with the shell's background timeout instead.
2. Accept or rebut each finding with evidence. Owner decisions D1-D20 are not reopened as preferences; a finding that shows a concrete defect in one goes to the owner.
3. Update the plan file and every affected `site-split-*` item, and append the agy dispositions to the plan's "Review record".
4. If agy is still unavailable, record that, ask the owner whether to substitute codex (gpt-6-astra, hard read-only) or skip, and do not start item 00 until answered.
